cases.title: Later comparative value must not overwrite the first-reported value
cases.question: Which CoreWeave Q2 2025 revenue value was knowable at the first tradable daily decision time after its August 2025 filing?
cases.passRule: Select the latest source vintage whose SEC acceptance timestamp is on or before the decision time. The August 2026 comparative is excluded.

cases.title: A later sign change must remain invisible to the earlier backtest
cases.question: Does a 2025 decision retain the positive first-reported other-investing value instead of importing the negative 2026 comparative?
cases.passRule: The earlier positive value remains active until the later filing is accepted; a sign flip in a later comparative cannot be backfilled.

cases.title: Preliminary evidence must not be treated as a completed filing
cases.question: Does the dataset preserve Super Micro as preliminary and outside the primary matrix before the completed Form 10-K?
cases.passRule: Before the completed filing, retain the preliminary source status and exclusion from the primary filed-company matrix.

cases.title: Unchanged values must still preserve evidence and tier changes
cases.question: Can the pipeline distinguish an unchanged Super Micro revenue-growth value from the stronger evidence path that supports it later?
cases.passRule: Report the evidence and comparability upgrade even when the derived numerical value remains unchanged.

cases.title: Role-matched issuers must not be presented as a synchronized calendar-quarter rank
cases.question: Does the pipeline keep different fiscal period ends visible before comparing NVIDIA and AMD?
cases.passRule: Preserve both fiscal period ends and reject a synchronized calendar-quarter ranking when the dates differ.
